findings.title: 4 Palestinians killed, 14 others wounded in Israeli ceasefire violations across Gaza
findings.location: Gaza Strip; reported injury locations include Jabalia, Al-Kanisa near Khan Younis, Al-Maslakh south of Khan Younis, and Al-Mawasi west of Khan Younis
findings.affected_population_system: Anadolu reports 14 Palestinians wounded in Saturday attacks, including a child and a woman. Medical sources attribute 8 injuries to a drone strike near Al-Maslakh and 2 serious injuries to a drone strike at Al-Mawasi; additional Jabalia and Al-Kanisa injuries are described. Earlier WAFA reporting counted 7 injuries in northern/southern Gaza, and some incident descriptions overlap. Four fatalities were already recorded and are not new.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Four Palestinians were killed and 14 others, including a child and a woman, were wounded in Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip on Saturday, according to medical sources.
findings.source_type: Established news agency, citing unnamed hospital medical sources

bounded_discovery_context.discovered_via: Targeted Anadolu source search #5 of 12, then opened full Anadolu article directly
bounded_discovery_context.publication_time_basis: Anadolu page states 21 November 2026 and 'Update: 21 November 2026' but no clock time
bounded_discovery_context.comparison_to_prior: WAFA's 09:08 Gaza-local report gave seven wounded from Jabalia and Khan Younis; a previous watch inspected an Anadolu six-injury report. This updated Anadolu account gives fourteen, but overlapping event descriptions prohibit adding seven or eight new individuals or claiming a precise increase. New information is the revised agency-level reported tally and specifically eight in Al-Maslakh.
relevant_miss_classes: military operations with documented civilian impact
bounded_discovery_context.caveats: Updated count has no independently corroborated casualty roster or timestamp. Distinctness of individual cases from earlier seven is unresolved. Do not add fourteen to previously counted injuries; no additional deaths. Attributed reports, not independent verification of attacks.
